name: pi-telegram-echo
description: Voice echo extension for the Pi coding agent + @llblab/pi-telegram bridge. Adds the 🎙️ reply showing the STT transcript of inbound voice/audio messages. STT is hardcoded to whisper-server (env vars WHISPER_SERVER_URL, PI_TELEGRAM_LANG); the section is registered once per session so the in-Telegram menu buttons stay stable across hot-reloads.
